source: SCAR GeoMAP v.2022-08, Cox et al. (2023), doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.951482, CC-BY-4.0
aggregation: majority vote by TRUE area (planar cell area / k^2)

gates.G2_gate: every pixel with data south of 53 S
gates.G2_first_statement_failed: stated as south of 60 S; failed, northernmost pixel -53.96: GeoMAP includes South Georgia. Restated, nothing was written by the failed run.

simpcode_descriptions.20: Unconsolidated colluvium, talus, alluvium and undifferentiated till
simpcode_descriptions.21: Youngest glacial gravel, till and supraglacial material (Holocene)
simpcode_descriptions.22: Unconsolidated coastal ice-shelf till, beach or lake deposits
simpcode_descriptions.30: Sedimentary rock with interbedded volcanic or volcaniclastic rock
simpcode_descriptions.31: Volcanic rock - basalt to rhyolite lava flows and pyroclastic material
simpcode_descriptions.32: Intrusive rock - granite, granodiorite, gabbro, or syenite (Eocene-Oligocene)
simpcode_descriptions.40: Sedimentary and volcanic rocks, pyroclastic material (Jurassic to Paleogene)
simpcode_descriptions.42: Ferrar Igneous Province and related volcanic and sedimentary rock (Jurassic)
simpcode_descriptions.43: Silicic volcanic and continental sedimentary rock (Jurassic)
simpcode_descriptions.44: Unmetamorphosed granitoid, gabbro and other intrusive rock
simpcode_descriptions.50: Beacon Supergroup and other sandstone-rich sedimentary rock (Devonian-Triassic)
simpcode_descriptions.60: Intrusive rock - granitoid, diorite, gabbro and orthogneiss
simpcode_descriptions.61: Folded low-grade metasedimentary and metavolcanic rock
simpcode_descriptions.62: Low to medium-grade metamorphic rock - schist, marble, metavolcanic, metasandstone
simpcode_descriptions.63: High-grade metamorphic rock - orthogneiss, paragneiss, schist and amphibolite
simpcode_descriptions.70: Metamorphic and intrusive rock - schist, gneiss, granulite, migmatite and anatectite
